what: Generic R Client for SeaTable Servers
title: Generic R Client for SeaTable Servers
text: ⚠️ Design-phase package. seatabler active design yet ready use. API unstable may change without notice. See seatabler-plan.md full design, scope rationale. seatabler server-agnostic R client SeaTable databases. seatable_connection captures server URL, environment variable (embedded literal value) holding API token, optional workspace; generic seatable_* functions query, read, write cache tables server. deliberately default server domain-specific logic: packages fafbseg bancr expected wrap seatabler server configuration users need setup.

title: Generic R Client for SeaTable Servers

title: Call a SeaTable REST endpoint directly — seatable_rest
text: transport behind seatable_archive_rows(), seatable_unarchive_rows() seatable_snapshots(), exported consumer packages can reach endpoints seatabler yet wrap without reimplementing authentication. Two details easy get wrong handled . Requests forced onto HTTP/1.1 (curl's CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1, numeric value 2), SeaTable's gateway can return HTTP/2 framing errors load. JSON bodies encode NA null rather string "NA", SeaTable rejects number columns. Rate-limited (429) server-error (5xx) responses retried exponential backoff; error statuses raise error carrying SeaTable's error_message supplies one.

title: Update or append rows in a SeaTable table — seatable_update_rows
text: SeaTable keeps unique _id every row, returned seatable_query(). update, keep column (named _id row_id) df; append need (warned supply one). Writes chunked chunksize rows API caps single call 1000. Multiple-select columns need care: SeaTable expects genuine list option names per cell, silently invents new option bare string handed instead. column SeaTable reports "multiple-select" auto-detected routed list-per-cell path; pass multi_select_cols override detection. scalar cell ("AB", comma-joined "AB,CD") accepted shorthand split commas — symmetric cell reads back — supply list-column directly ((list(c("AB", "CD")))), also lets write option name contains comma. Every resulting value checked column's existing vocabulary rejected unless already option; see allow_new_options seatable_add_select_options(). Big data (bigdata = TRUE, append ): rows go add-archived-rows REST endpoint straight archived storage, rather ordinary grid via SDK. bulk loads exceed base's grid row cap; base must big data enabled gateway returns error. title: seatabler — plan
text: generic R client SeaTable servers, factored seatable code currently embedded fafbseg (independently bancr). seatabler provides server-agnostic core — connect, query, read, write, cache — default server domain logic. Consumer packages (fafbseg, bancr, crantr, aedes) supply server configuration keep flywire/CAVE/neuroglancer domain functions. document self-contained: captures design, function inventory, backward-compatibility constraints, phased plan, work can resume fresh session without prior context.

title: seatabler — plan
text: Two things drive : clean multi-server configuration story. existing seatable code written around single Cambridge server, URL held global option (fafbseg.flytable.url) token fixed environment variable (FLYTABLE_TOKEN). Supporting additional servers far meant either temporarily mutating global option (crantr::crant_meta() cloud.seatable.io) passing url/token/workspace_id every function (bancr ). Neither clean. first-class connection object solves properly central deliverable . Consolidation. Generic seatable functionality currently exists two places — fafbseg bancr — overlap. bancr also implements useful capabilities fafbseg lacks (see §5). shared package lets consumers converge one implementation share improvements. connection abstraction prize; code consolidation follows .

title: seatabler — plan
text: Consumers depend seatabler (directly transitively via fafbseg) keep flywire/CAVE/materialisation/neuroglancer logic. Nothing domain- specific moves seatabler.
code: ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐         │  seatabler  (generic, no default server)      │         │                                                │         │  seatable_connection(url, token_envvar,        │         │                      workspace_id, cachedir)   │         │  default_connection() / with_connection()      │         │                                                │         │  seatable_login / _base / _query / _columns     │         │  seatable_list_rows / _update_rows / _append…   │         │  seatable_cached_table (+ delta sync)           │         │  multi-select + coltype helpers                 │         └───────────────┬────────────────────────────────┘                         │ (each consumer binds ONE connection)       ┌─────────────────┼───────────────────┬──────────────┐       ▼                 ▼                   ▼              ▼    fafbseg           bancr               crantr         aedes   flytable_* +     banctable_* +       crant_meta,    aedes_* meta   cam_meta,        franken_meta,       CAVE/mesh via  via fafbseg   cell_types,      ngl_update,         fafbseg        wrappers   meta (domain)    status (domain)

title: seatabler — plan
text: Chosen approach: connection object resolvable default, bound wrapper layer. combines strengths three candidate designs (explicit object / package options+envvar / per-function args) avoiding one’s drawback. seatable_connection(url, token_envvar, workspace_id, cachedir, name) unit configuration. stores token environment-variable name, token value, connections safe print, share inspect. token resolved lazily call time via seatable_token(con). Generic functions take con = default_connection(). default_connection() returns registered “current” connection, builds one seatabler.url / seatabler.token_envvar / seatabler.workspace_id options, errors guidance URL available. interactive users can set default never pass con. Wrapper packages bind connection, end users never see triple. fafbseg::flytable_query() supplies Cambridge connection internally; crant_meta() supplies crantr connection; banctable_query() supplies bancr’s. Multiple servers simply multiple connection objects — global mutation, per-call argument sprawl. directly resolves existing pain points: crantr’s “mutate global option mid-call” becomes “bind crantr connection”, bancr’s “pass url/token/workspace everywhere” becomes “one connection instance”. Locking contract (connection constructor + default resolved) one thing must agreed wider surgery, touches every function signature. Everything else cheap independent. Sketch (see R/connection.R initial implementation): Consumer bindings (pattern show Alex — real, minimal wrappers):
code: con <- seatable_connection(   url          = "https://flytable.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/",   token_envvar = "FLYTABLE_TOKEN",   workspace_id = NULL)             # discovered from base name if NULL  df <- seatable_query("SELECT * FROM info", con = con)  # or set a session default and drop the argument set_default_connection(con) df <- seatable_query("SELECT * FROM info") # fafbseg .flytable_con <- function() seatable_connection(   url = getOption("fafbseg.flytable.url", "https://flytable.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/"),   token_envvar = "FLYTABLE_TOKEN") flytable_query <- function(sql, ...) seatabler::seatable_query(sql, con = .flytable_con(), ...)  # bancr .banctable_con <- function() seatable_connection(   url = "https://cloud.seatable.io/", token_envvar = "BANCTABLE_TOKEN",   workspace_id = "57832") banctable_query <- function(sql, ...) seatabler::seatable_query(sql, con = .banctable_con(), ...)  # crantr (replaces the withr::local_options URL-mutation hack) .crant_con <- function() seatable_connection(   url = "https://cloud.seatable.io/", token_envvar = "CRANTTABLE_TOKEN")
